key_terms.مَوْضُونَةٍ: wrought or woven (specifically with gold threads)

ai.seo_question: What does 'couches wrought of gold' signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'woven couches' (surur) symbolize both the refined comfort of the hereafter and the structured, orderly nature of divine reward, contrasting with the chaos of worldly life. This imagery is often linked to the concept of 'Izzah' (honor) granted to the faithful, reflecting the physical and spiritual elevation described in traditions regarding the dwellings of the Ahl al-Bayt and the righteous. The specific mention of weaving underscores the craftsmanship and permanence of these blessings, serving as a tangible sign of God's mercy.
